_comment: Single source of truth for vault actions. Read by _templates/actions.md (the Templater launcher / Cmd+T) AND by the 'Vault Actions' panel in _HOME.md. Keep template `name`/`display` strings in sync with the suggester wording. All files live in _scripts/templates/.

categories.label: Notes
categories.display: 📓 Write & Take Notes — Ideas, lab notes, protocols

templates.label: Post-it
templates.name: 🗒️ Post-it — Add a quick sticky note to the Home dashboard
templates.desc:
What it does: Adds a small sticky note to the Home dashboard.
When to use it: For a short reminder that doesn't need a full note file.

templates.label: Idea
templates.name: 💡 Idea — Capture a quick idea → 00_STAGING/ideas/
templates.desc:
What it does: Captures a quick idea in the staging area.
When to use it: To jot down a fast concept or thought to elaborate later.

templates.label: Lab Note
templates.name: 🔬 Lab Note — Lab note with date + experiment ID → 00_STAGING/_daily/
templates.desc:
What it does: Creates a dated lab note with an experiment ID.
When to use it: To record daily experimental procedures, raw observations, or lab work.

templates.label: Protocol
templates.name: 📋 Protocol — Create a protocol (wet/dry lab, morphometry...) → 03_KNOWLEDGE/protocols/
templates.desc:
What it does: Generates a standard protocol template (wet/dry lab, morphometry, etc.).
When to use it: To document reusable step-by-step methodologies or experimental guidelines.

templates.label: New Project
templates.name: 🆕 New Project — Full research project scaffold: folders, Gantt, KPI
templates.desc:
What it does: Sets up a full project folder structure, including Gantt chart and KPI tracking.
When to use it: When initiating a new scientific research study or publication project.

templates.label: New Journal Round
templates.name: 📬 New Journal Round — Add a submission/revision round to an existing project
templates.desc:
What it does: Creates a folder round structure for paper revisions or submissions.
When to use it: When submitting a paper to a journal or preparing a revision round.

templates.label: LaTeX Abstract
templates.name: 📝 LaTeX Abstract — Create a LaTeX template for a conference abstract
templates.desc:
What it does: Generates a LaTeX abstract file, prompting for authors from the DB and target folder.
When to use it: When writing an abstract for a conference or workshop presentation.

templates.label: New Review
templates.name: ✍️ New Review — Full peer review workspace: folders, task list, deadlines → 09_PEER_REVIEWS/
templates.desc:
What it does: Scaffolds a workspace for a journal peer review, with task lists and deadlines.
When to use it: When invited by a journal editor to review a submitted manuscript.

templates.label: New Round
templates.name: 🔁 New Round — Add a review round to an existing peer review
templates.desc:
What it does: Adds another round of review for an existing peer review project.
When to use it: When a revised manuscript is sent back to you for re-evaluation.

templates.label: New Grant
templates.name: 💼 New Grant — Create a new grant proposal workspace → 02_GRANTS/
templates.desc:
What it does: Creates a workspace to prepare a funding or grant proposal.
When to use it: When applying for research funding, grants, or fellowships.

templates.label: New Conference
templates.name: 🎯 New Conference — Conference/workshop workspace from programme → 05_ADMIN/missions/conferences/
templates.desc:
What it does: Creates a workspace for a conference or workshop based on its program.
When to use it: When attending, preparing, or organizing a scientific conference or workshop.

templates.label: Fieldwork
templates.name: 🥾 Fieldwork — Fieldwork mission workspace → 05_ADMIN/missions/fieldwork/
templates.desc:
What it does: Scaffolds a mission workspace for field expeditions and sampling.
When to use it: When planning or executing botanical/zoological collection trips or field studies.

categories.label: System
categories.display: ⚙️ System & Utilities — file conversions, file recovery, edit people database

templates.label: PDF → Markdown
templates.name: 📄 PDF → Markdown — Convert a PDF to Markdown

templates.label: Transcribe Audio
templates.name: 🎙️ Transcribe Audio — Transcribe an audio file embedded in this note (Whisper + Ollama)
templates.desc:
What it does: Transcribes an ![[audio]] file embedded in the current note and stamps the cleaned transcript right under the embed.
When to use it: To turn a recorded lecture, meeting, or voice memo already dropped into a note into text.

templates.label: Export → LaTeX / PDF
templates.name: 📝 Export → LaTeX / PDF — Export current note to .tex or .pdf

templates.label: File Recovery
templates.name: 🩹 File Recovery — Open Obsidian native file recovery tool
templates.desc:
What it does: Opens Obsidian's native local history.
When to use it: To recover recently lost edits or text (minutes/hours ago) that are not yet included in a Git backup.

templates.label: Recover Deleted File
templates.name: 🗑️ Recover Deleted File — Find deleted files in git backups and restore them
templates.desc:
What it does: Searches and extracts deleted files from the Git history.
When to use it: If you deleted a whole file in the past and want to restore it to the vault.

templates.label: Restore Past Version
templates.name: 🔄 Restore Past Version — Roll back the current note to an earlier backup
templates.desc:
What it does: Overwrites the current note with a previous version from Git.
When to use it: If you made incorrect edits to a note and want to rollback its state to an earlier backup.

templates.label: Preview Past Version
templates.name: 👁️ Preview Past Version — View a past version of the current note read-only
templates.desc:
What it does: Opens a previous version from Git in read-only mode.
When to use it: To compare or consult the old content of a note without overwriting the current one.

templates.label: Recover Renamed File
templates.name: 📦 Recover Renamed File — Restore a moved/renamed file to its original location
templates.desc:
What it does: Locates renamed or moved files in the Git history.
When to use it: If you lost track of a moved or renamed note and want to restore it to its original path.

templates.label: Browse Backup Commit
templates.name: 🔍 Browse Backup Commit — View files touched in a specific backup
templates.desc:
What it does: Shows all files modified in a specific Git commit.
When to use it: To examine the overall state of the vault at a specific point in the backup history.

templates.label: View Collaborator Info
templates.name: 🪪 View Collaborator Info — View details of a collaborator on the dashboard

templates.label: Edit Collaborator
templates.name: 👥 Edit Collaborator — Modify an existing collaborator in the People DB

templates.label: Add Collaborator
templates.name: ➕ Add Collaborator — Add a new collaborator to the People DB
